title: Goedel-Prover-V2: Scaling Formal Theorem Proving with Scaffolded Data Synthesis and Self-Correction
paper_type_zh: 前沿形式化定理证明技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要审计合成形式化数据、Lean 反馈、自我修正与后训练披露边界的读者
one_line: Goedel-Prover-V2 builds Lean proof models through verified whole-proof SFT, compiler-error self-correction data, scaffolded theorem synthesis, hybrid GRPO, and model averaging; public models and evaluation artifacts exist, but the core S1/S2/S3 training records are not released.
Goedel-Prover-V2 报告了支架式合成任务生成、基于 Lean 编译器反馈的自我修正、expert iteration 与强化学习；但本 Card 尚未核验其逐条数据、验证环境及具体发布工件。
why: For the frontier disclosure track, it exposes how theorem statements, long proof traces, compiler feedback, and verifier rewards enter distinct post-training stages while preserving the gap between formal acceptance, semantic faithfulness, and release completeness.
inclusion_reason: A frontier formal-theorem-proving report with unusually concrete disclosure of scaffolded statement construction, compiler-error correction records, verifier-backed expert iteration, RL sampling, and checkpoint averaging, together with official models, inference code, and an evaluation dataset.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Formal theorem proving provides a stronger terminal check than natural-language math: a Lean proof either compiles for the supplied statement in the configured environment or it does not. The remaining data problem is harder than collecting successful proofs. A useful prover must receive sufficiently varied formal statements, learn long proof plans, recover from compiler failures, and avoid collapsing to a narrow set of proof patterns after repeated expert iteration and reinforcement learning.

Goedel-Prover-V2 treats those requirements as separate construction stages. It first builds verified whole-proof supervision, then adds records that pair a failed proof with Lean compiler feedback and a correction, expands the statement pool through two scaffolded synthesis routes, and finally applies reinforcement learning plus checkpoint averaging. The relevant objects are therefore not only final proofs: they include formalized statements, failed attempts, compiler errors, corrected attempts, extracted subgoals, synthetic variants, rollout rewards, and checkpoint lineage.

The verification boundary remains narrow. Lean acceptance establishes a proof of the supplied formal statement under a particular Lean/mathlib setup. It does not establish that an autoformalized statement faithfully represents its natural-language source, that the source is uncontaminated, or that the unreleased training records can be independently reconstructed.

形式化定理证明比自然语言数学拥有更强的终态检查：在给定环境中，一份 Lean 证明要么能通过编译，要么不能。但数据问题并不止于收集成功证明。一个可用的 prover 还需要覆盖足够多样的形式化陈述，学习长篇证明规划，利用编译器失败信息进行修正，并避免在反复 expert iteration 与强化学习后收缩到少数证明模式。

Goedel-Prover-V2 将这些要求拆成不同构造阶段：先生成经验证的完整证明监督，再加入“失败证明—Lean 编译器反馈—修正结果”记录，通过两种 scaffolded synthesis 路线扩展陈述池，最后进行强化学习和 checkpoint averaging。因此，关键数据对象不只是最终证明，还包括形式化陈述、失败尝试、编译错误、修正尝试、提取子目标、合成变体、rollout 奖励和 checkpoint 谱系。

验证边界仍然有限。Lean 接受只说明在特定 Lean/mathlib 配置下，候选证明了所提供的形式化陈述；它不能证明自动形式化忠实表达自然语言来源，也不能证明来源无污染或未发布的训练记录可被独立重建。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The training lineage is organized as S1 → S2 → S3 → RL-AVG.

  • S1, whole-proof supervision. DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B run large-scale inference on curated Lean statements. Lean-verified complete proofs with reasoning traces form the initial SFT data. Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B are fine-tuned on S1.
  • S2, self-correction supervision. SFT-S1 and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B annotate examples containing a statement, an SFT-model output, and its associated compiler error. These correction records are merged into S1 and used for another SFT stage.
  • S3, scaffolded statements. The averaged SFT-S2 model helps generate additional statements. Formal scaffolding extracts unsolved Lean goals with their preconditions from failed proof attempts and also considers their negations. Informal scaffolding asks Qwen3-32B to create easier subproblems or harder variants, then runs autoformalization and correctness/difficulty filtering.
  • RL-AVG, verifier-backed optimization. A 50/50 multi-task mixture trains whole-proof generation and first-round correction. Lean supplies reward calls; model averaging is applied after SFT and again after RL to recover output diversity.

This is a frontier recipe rather than a complete data release. The official project provides model weights, inference and self-correction code, a Lean compiler wrapper, a pinned mathlib submodule, and MathOlympiadBench. It does not expose the full S1/S2/S3 tables, all rollouts, rejected attempts, or per-item lineage.

训练谱系按 S1 → S2 → S3 → RL-AVG 组织。

  • S1：完整证明监督。 DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 与 DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B 在整理后的 Lean 陈述上进行大规模推理；带推理轨迹且通过 Lean 的完整证明构成初始 SFT 数据，随后用于微调 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32B。
  • S2：自我修正监督。 SFT-S1 与 DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B 标注“陈述、SFT 模型输出、对应编译错误”组成的样本。修正记录并入 S1，再进行一轮 SFT。
  • S3：支架式陈述。 平均后的 SFT-S2 模型参与生成新陈述。形式化路线从失败证明中提取带前提的未解 Lean 目标，并同时考虑其否定；非形式化路线让 Qwen3-32B 为未解题生成较简单子题、为已解题生成更难变体，再经过自动形式化以及正确性/难度筛选。
  • RL-AVG：验证器支持的优化。 训练按 50/50 混合完整证明生成和首轮修正任务，Lean 提供奖励调用；SFT 后与 RL 后都进行 model averaging，以恢复输出多样性。

这是一份前沿配方披露，而不是完整数据发布。官方项目公开了模型权重、推理与自我修正代码、Lean 编译器封装、固定的 mathlib 子模块和 MathOlympiadBench，但没有公开完整 S1/S2/S3 表、全部 rollout、拒绝尝试或逐条谱系。

title: Method
方法
html:
Formalizer construction precedes prover training. The paper reports that an initial 50K examples, including reasoning traces, are generated with Claude Sonnet 4. Goedel-Formalizer-V2 is then improved through expert iteration: proposed Lean statements must pass syntax checking and repeated LLM semantic evaluation before entering the next SFT round. On a 300-problem OmniMath comparison, the paper reports 228 passing formalizations for Goedel-Formalizer-V2 versus 161 for Kimina-Autoformalizer; this is a formalizer evaluation, not a per-item certificate for the training pool.

Scaffolded synthesis has two routes. The formal route applies Lean's extract goal tactic to unsolved states appearing in failed proof attempts. Extracted goals plus preconditions become new statements; because such a statement need not be provable, its negation is also added as a candidate. The informal route has Qwen3-32B first solve a source problem in natural language, then propose easier/subproblems if it is unsolved or harder variants if it is solved. These are autoformalized, screened by an LLM for mathematical correctness and difficulty, and exact-match deduplicated. Repeated judging is intended to reduce false rejection of hard items, but the error rate is not reported.

The SFT pipeline begins with teacher-generated, Lean-verified whole proofs (S1). SFT-S1 and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B then generate correction annotations; the latter run is reported to use NeMo-Skills on 144 H100s. S2 merges correction data into S1. SFT-S2 is averaged with the Qwen3 base model, used for scaffolded generation, and fine-tuned on S3. The resulting SFT-S3-AVG initializes RL.

RL mixes whole-proof and first-correction prompts equally. The appendix reports 50K challenging statements and 50K self-correction samples; each correction input includes a statement, failed model output, and error message. Training uses VeRL for one epoch, batch size 128, n=8 parallel rollouts and Lean reward calls, mini-batch size 32, and a three-times oversampling pool. Prompts with pass rate 0 or above 0.75 are removed by dynamic sampling. Maximum prompt and response lengths are 16K and 24K, with a 4K overlong buffer and penalty factor 1. The objective uses token-averaged policy loss without KL or entropy terms. Generation temperature, random seeds, exact theorem-source proportions, and full accepted/rejected record counts remain unknown.

At inference, the main self-correction setup allows two revision rounds in a 40K context. Each failed proof is compiled, the specific error is returned alongside prior reasoning, and the model revises the proof. A 128K-context ablation permits five rounds. Official code targets Linux/Python 3.10 and Lean 4.9 with the corresponding Mathlib; the repository pins a mathlib4 submodule, but no immutable container digest is supplied.

Formalizer 构造先于 prover 训练。论文报告用 Claude Sonnet 4 生成初始 50K 条样本并附带推理轨迹，之后通过 expert iteration 改进 Goedel-Formalizer-V2：候选 Lean 陈述必须同时通过语法检查与多次 LLM 语义评估，才进入下一轮 SFT。在 300 道 OmniMath 对比中，Goedel-Formalizer-V2 有 228 道通过，Kimina-Autoformalizer 为 161 道；这是 formalizer 层面的评测，不是对训练池每条记录的质量证明。

Scaffolded synthesis 有两条路线。形式化路线对失败证明中的未解状态调用 Lean 的 extract goal tactic，把提取目标及其前提作为新陈述；由于该陈述未必可证，流程也将其否定作为候选。非形式化路线先让 Qwen3-32B 用自然语言尝试求解源问题，再为未解题生成较简单子题、为已解题生成较难变体；随后进行自动形式化、LLM 数学正确性与难度筛选，并按精确匹配去重。重复判断旨在降低误删难题的概率，但论文没有报告筛选错误率。

SFT 流程从教师生成且经 Lean 验证的完整证明 S1 开始。SFT-S1 和 DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B 随后生成修正标注，其中后者的推理据报通过 NeMo-Skills 使用 144 张 H100。S2 将修正数据并入 S1；SFT-S2 与 Qwen3 base model 做参数平均后用于支架式生成，再在 S3 上微调，所得 SFT-S3-AVG 作为 RL 初始化。

RL 等比例混合完整证明 prompt 与首轮修正 prompt。附录报告准备 50K 个高难陈述和 50K 条自我修正样本；每个修正输入包含陈述、失败模型输出和错误信息。训练使用 VeRL 跑一个 epoch，batch size 128，n=8 并行 rollout 与 Lean 奖励调用，mini-batch size 32，并用三倍 batch 的过采样池。动态采样删除通过率为 0 或高于 0.75 的 prompt。最大 prompt/response 长度分别为 16K/24K，另有 4K overlong buffer 和系数 1；目标采用 token 平均 policy loss，不含 KL 或 entropy 项。生成温度、随机种子、定理来源精确比例和完整接受/拒绝计数仍为 unknown。

推理时，主自我修正配置在 40K 上下文内最多允许两轮修订：失败证明送入编译器，再将具体错误与先前推理一并返回模型。128K 上下文消融最多允许五轮。官方代码面向 Linux/Python 3.10，并使用 Lean 4.9 及相应 Mathlib；仓库固定了 mathlib4 子模块，但没有提供不可变容器摘要。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports three kinds of evidence that should remain separate.

  • Formalizer evidence. On 300 OmniMath problems, Goedel-Formalizer-V2 yields 228 passing formalizations and Kimina-Autoformalizer 161. Passing the paper's checks supports the formalizer comparison, but does not quantify semantic error over the full synthesized statement pool.
  • Correction evidence. On MiniF2F at pass@32, the 32B model rises from 88.1% in standard mode to 90.4% with self-correction; the 8B model rises from 84.6% to 86.7%. Removing compiler error messages substantially hurts the correction ablation, and removing previous chains of thought causes a smaller decline. This shows the feedback is operationally useful, not that every correction trace is mathematically informative.
  • Training and diversity evidence. RL improves pass@1, while checkpoint averaging can recover pass@N diversity that declines in later training. Different averaging coefficients and RL checkpoints trade off pass@1 and pass@N, so the final model is not attributable to data alone.
  • Artifact evidence. The official repository contains inference/self-correction scripts, a Lean compiler wrapper, a mathlib4 submodule, and benchmark JSONL files. Official 8B and 32B Hugging Face model pages exist. MathOlympiadBench exposes 360 rows with formal statements, informal prefixes, proof code/solved fields, source identifiers, and categories under an Apache-2.0 tag.

Benchmark results demonstrate end-to-end utility under the reported inference budgets. They do not certify the unreleased S1/S2/S3 records, prove faithful autoformalization, or substitute for data lineage and decontamination.

论文给出三类应当分开理解的证据。

  • Formalizer 证据。 在 300 道 OmniMath 题上，Goedel-Formalizer-V2 有 228 道通过，Kimina-Autoformalizer 为 161 道。通过论文中的检查支持 formalizer 对比，但没有量化整个合成陈述池的语义错误率。
  • 修正证据。 在 MiniF2F pass@32 上，32B 模型由标准模式的 88.1% 提升到自我修正模式的 90.4%，8B 模型由 84.6% 提升到 86.7%。去掉具体编译错误会明显降低修正效果，去掉此前 CoT 也会造成较小下降。这说明反馈在系统中有用，但不能证明每条修正轨迹都包含有意义的数学信息。
  • 训练与多样性证据。 RL 提高 pass@1，而 checkpoint averaging 可以恢复训练后期下降的 pass@N 多样性。不同 averaging 系数与 RL checkpoint 在 pass@1 和 pass@N 之间存在权衡，因此最终模型效果不能只归因于数据。
  • 工件证据。 官方仓库包含推理/自我修正脚本、Lean 编译器封装、mathlib4 子模块和 benchmark JSONL；官方 8B/32B Hugging Face 模型页可用。MathOlympiadBench 以 Apache-2.0 标签发布 360 行，包含形式化陈述、非形式化前缀、证明代码或 solved 字段、来源标识和类别。

基准结果说明在所报告预算下端到端流程有效，但不能为未发布的 S1/S2/S3 逐条背书，也不能证明自动形式化忠实，或替代数据谱系与去污染审计。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Relative to whole-proof pipelines that only sample fresh completions, Goedel-Prover-V2 makes compiler-guided revision a trained behavior. The correction object explicitly preserves a failed output and its Lean error, and the model is optimized on both initial proof generation and first-round repair. The paper's ablations further distinguish the value of the concrete compiler message from simply resampling or retaining a previous proof.

The second contribution is curriculum construction around the current prover. Formal scaffolding recycles unsolved proof states into easier statements; informal scaffolding asks for easier or harder variants depending on whether the source theorem is currently solved. Statement generation is therefore conditioned on a moving capability boundary rather than a fixed corpus.

The third contribution is to treat model averaging as part of the post-training data story. Expert iteration and RL increase pass@1 while sometimes shrinking sample diversity; averaging with a base or earlier checkpoint restores pass@N. This means the final performance comes from the interaction of statement mixture, accepted traces, reward sampling, and checkpoint composition.

None of these components is presented here as independently new in isolation. The direction signal is their integration into a disclosed S1/S2/S3/RL lineage with formal feedback. Because the core training rows remain unavailable, the contribution is best recorded as a frontier-pipeline disclosure with partial release, not as an open training dataset.

相对于只重新采样完整证明的 whole-proof pipeline，Goedel-Prover-V2 把编译器指导的修订训练成模型行为。修正对象明确保留失败输出与对应 Lean 错误，模型同时优化初始证明生成和首轮修复；论文消融还把“具体编译错误”的作用与简单重采样或仅保留先前证明区分开。

第二项贡献是围绕当前 prover 能力构造 curriculum。形式化支架把未解证明状态转化为更容易的陈述；非形式化支架则根据源定理当前是否已解，生成更易或更难的变体。因此，陈述生成受不断变化的能力边界约束，而不是固定语料。

第三项贡献是把 model averaging 纳入后训练数据解释。Expert iteration 与 RL 提高 pass@1，却可能降低样本多样性；与 base 或早期 checkpoint 平均可恢复 pass@N。这意味着最终性能来自陈述混合、接受轨迹、奖励采样与 checkpoint 组合的共同作用。

这里不把任一组件单独宣称为本文首次提出。真正的方向信号是把它们整合进一条有形式反馈的 S1/S2/S3/RL 谱系。由于核心训练行仍不可获得，最准确的定位是“部分发布的前沿训练管线披露”，而不是开放训练数据集。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The core construction records are not public: the full source statement manifest, Claude Sonnet 4 formalizer examples, teacher whole-proof traces, S1/S2/S3 tables, failed attempts, compiler messages, correction targets, RL rollouts, reward logs, and per-item generator/checkpoint lineage. Models and inference code therefore do not make the training dataset independently auditable.

Formal verification has two semantic boundaries. A Lean-successful proof is valid only for the supplied formal theorem in the configured environment. Autoformalization can still alter assumptions or conclusions, and extracted goals from failed proofs can be mathematically unhelpful or unprovable. The paper uses LLM semantic judging and correctness/difficulty filters, but does not report their false-accept or false-reject rates.

The feedback distribution is selective. Expert iteration retains verified successes, while RL dynamic sampling removes prompts with pass rate 0 and prompts above 0.75. Failed easy and persistently unsolved cases are therefore treated differently, and the public report does not expose enough records to measure the resulting domain or difficulty skew.

Reproduction also depends on versioning. The repository points to Lean 4.9 and pins a mathlib4 submodule, but does not publish immutable containers for every experiment. Main-text and appendix wording differ on whether the 32B RL run consumed about 67K or 64K unique inputs. Exact temperatures, seeds, source proportions, per-stage yields, averaging coefficients for the final released models, and broad train/benchmark overlap remain unknown.

The official repository and MathOlympiadBench state Apache-2.0, but that does not automatically resolve licenses for every upstream theorem corpus, natural-language source, teacher output, or derived training record. Benchmark gains are aggregate utility evidence, not proof of training-data quality.

核心构造记录没有公开：完整源陈述清单、Claude Sonnet 4 formalizer 样本、教师完整证明轨迹、S1/S2/S3 表、失败尝试、编译消息、修正目标、RL rollout、奖励日志和逐条生成器/checkpoint 谱系。模型与推理代码因此不能让训练数据本身变得可独立审计。

形式验证有两层语义边界。Lean 成功只说明在给定环境下候选证明了所提供的形式化定理；自动形式化仍可能改变假设或结论，从失败证明提取的目标也可能数学意义不足或不可证。论文使用 LLM 语义判断以及正确性/难度筛选，却没有报告其假阳性或假阴性率。

反馈分布具有选择性。Expert iteration 保留验证成功样本；RL 动态采样删除通过率为 0 和高于 0.75 的 prompt。容易失败与长期未解样本因此受到不同处理，公开报告也没有足够记录来度量由此产生的领域或难度偏差。

复现还依赖版本固定。仓库指向 Lean 4.9 并固定 mathlib4 子模块，但没有为各实验提供不可变容器。正文与附录对 32B RL 使用约 67K 还是 64K 个唯一输入表述不一致。精确温度、随机种子、来源比例、逐阶段产率、最终发布模型的 averaging 系数和广泛训练—基准重叠仍为 unknown。

官方仓库与 MathOlympiadBench 声明 Apache-2.0，但这不会自动解决每个上游定理语料、自然语言来源、教师输出或衍生训练记录的许可问题。基准增益是聚合效用证据，不是训练数据质量证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger track, this paper is useful as a staged disclosure map rather than a reusable training corpus.

  • It separates statement construction, whole-proof SFT, compiler-error correction data, scaffolded augmentation, RL reward calls, and checkpoint averaging.
  • It provides a concrete self-correction record schema—statement, failed output, compiler error, and revision—that can guide releases of verifier-backed trajectories.
  • It offers two curriculum mechanisms to compare: formal goal extraction from failed attempts and informal difficulty adjustment followed by autoformalization.
  • It exposes how dynamic pass-rate filtering and model averaging can change both the accepted data distribution and pass@N diversity.
  • Its official Lean wrapper, pinned mathlib submodule, batch self-correction script, model weights, and MathOlympiadBench support inference and evaluation studies.

A reuse audit should pin repository, model, Lean, and mathlib revisions; distinguish MathOlympiadBench from training data; retain every compiler verdict and correction round; sample-check autoformalization semantics; and request source, license, split, and overlap manifests for S1/S2/S3. Without those additions, the work supports recipe comparison and verifier-loop research, but not reconstruction of the reported training mixture.

对 Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger 方向而言，本文更适合作为分阶段披露地图，而不是可直接复用的训练语料。

  • 它区分陈述构造、完整证明 SFT、编译错误修正数据、支架式扩增、RL 奖励调用和 checkpoint averaging。
  • 它给出具体自我修正记录结构——陈述、失败输出、编译错误与修订——可用于设计验证器支持的轨迹发布。
  • 它提供两类可比较的 curriculum：从失败尝试提取形式目标，以及生成非形式化难度变体后再自动形式化。
  • 它显示动态通过率筛选与 model averaging 会同时改变接受数据分布和 pass@N 多样性。
  • 官方 Lean 封装、固定 mathlib 子模块、批量自我修正脚本、模型权重与 MathOlympiadBench 支持推理和评测研究。

复用审计应固定仓库、模型、Lean 与 mathlib 修订，严格区分 MathOlympiadBench 和训练数据，保留每次编译判定与修正轮次，抽样检查自动形式化语义，并要求 S1/S2/S3 的来源、许可、划分和重叠清单。在这些信息补齐前，该工作适合配方比较与验证闭环研究，但不能用于重建所报告的训练混合。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the pipeline as S1 whole proofs → S2 compiler-error corrections → S3 scaffolded statements → verifier-backed RL and model averaging.
  • A self-correction sample contains a statement, a failed model output, and a Lean error message; the public release does not expose the full correction corpus.
  • RL uses eight rollouts per input and removes prompts with pass rate 0 or above 0.75, so reward data are conditioned on a moving difficulty filter.
  • Lean acceptance verifies the formal statement under the pinned environment, not the semantics or provenance of an autoformalized source.
  • Treat official models, inference code, and MathOlympiadBench as released artifacts, not substitutes for the unreleased S1/S2/S3 and rollout ledgers.
  • Reconcile the 32B RL input count (64K in the appendix, 67K in the main text) and pin all model/Lean/mathlib revisions before reproduction.

• 按 S1 完整证明 → S2 编译错误修正 → S3 支架式陈述 → 验证器支持的 RL 与 model averaging 阅读整条流程。
  • 一条自我修正样本包含陈述、失败模型输出和 Lean 错误消息；公开发布没有提供完整修正语料。
  • RL 每个输入使用 8 个 rollout，并删除通过率为 0 或高于 0.75 的 prompt，因此奖励数据受不断变化的难度筛选约束。
  • Lean 接受验证的是固定环境下的形式化陈述，而不是自动形式化来源的语义或谱系。
  • 官方模型、推理代码和 MathOlympiadBench 是已发布工件，不能替代未发布的 S1/S2/S3 与 rollout 账本。
  • 复现前应核对 32B RL 输入计数（附录 64K、正文 67K），并固定模型、Lean 与 mathlib 的全部修订。

value.html: Lean 4 statements assembled from existing formal corpora, natural-language mathematics autoformalized by Goedel-Formalizer-V2, formal and informal scaffolded variants, and self-correction inputs. The paper does not publish a complete source manifest or per-item provenance.

A theorem prompt is paired with long natural-language proof planning and Lean 4 proof code. A self-correction record contains the statement, a failed SFT-model output, and its Lean compiler error message; the corrected continuation is the training target or RL action.

DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B produce initial whole-proof SFT traces; SFT-S1 and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B annotate self-correction traces; later Goedel-Prover-V2 checkpoints produce expert-iteration and RL rollouts. Claude Sonnet 4 supplies 50K initial formalizer examples, and Qwen3-32B generates and filters informal scaffolded statements.

Official code targets Linux and Python 3.10, follows Lean 4.9 with the corresponding Mathlib, and pins a mathlib4 submodule in the repository. Exact immutable container image, hardware/runtime pins, and the environment used for every training record are not published.

Lean compilation supplies terminal proof reward and error messages for correction. RL uses a hybrid GRPO-style objective without group normalization or KL, with clip-higher, overlong penalties, DAPO-style dynamic sampling, and eight parallel rollouts per input; inputs with empirical pass rate 0 or above 0.75 are filtered from optimization.

A candidate is successful when the supplied Lean 4 statement compiles under the configured Lean/mathlib environment. This proves the formal statement in that environment, not that an upstream natural-language problem was faithfully formalized.
Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B

DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B for whole-proof SFT; SFT-S1 plus DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B for self-correction annotation; Claude Sonnet 4 for 50K initial formalizer examples; Qwen3-32B for informal scaffold generation and filtering.

The S1→S2→S3 pipeline first collects verified whole proofs, adds compiler-error self-correction records, then augments theorem statements through formal goal extraction and informal problem variation followed by autoformalization.

S1 is produced by large-scale inference with DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B/671B. S2 adds self-correction data annotated by SFT-S1 and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B. S3 adds scaffolded statements generated from SFT-S2-AVG. RL mixes whole-proof generation and first-round self-correction 50/50 for one epoch.
unknown

Formalizer examples must pass Lean syntax checks and repeated LLM semantic evaluation; informal scaffolded statements are filtered for correctness and difficulty, trivial or incorrect statements are discarded while negations of incorrect statements may be retained, and exact-match duplicates are removed. Expert-iteration proof traces require Lean success. RL dynamically excludes prompts with pass rate 0 or greater than 0.75.

RL uses batch size 128, eight parallel rollouts, mini-batch size 32, up to 16K prompt tokens and 24K response tokens with a 4K overlong buffer. Main self-correction evaluation uses at most two revision rounds in a 40K context; a 128K-context ablation uses up to five revisions.

VeRL hybrid GRPO: no group normalization, no KL or entropy term, token-averaged policy loss, clip-higher, overlong penalty factor 1, DAPO-style dynamic sampling, and model averaging after SFT and RL. The paper reports about 46K and 64K unique RL inputs for 8B and 32B, while the main text elsewhere says 67K for 32B; that discrepancy should remain visible.

The disclosed mixture includes existing Lean statements, autoformalized natural-language math, formal goal-extraction variants, Qwen3-32B informal variants, whole-proof traces, and compiler-error correction traces. Exact corpus names, proportions, licensing, and item-level source mappings are not fully published.

Training uses 50K challenging statements and 50K self-correction samples for RL preparation; about 46K inputs are consumed by 8B and 64K or 67K by 32B depending on appendix versus main-text wording. The public MathOlympiadBench has 360 train rows as a packaging split and is an evaluation benchmark, not the training corpus.
The paper reports benchmark evaluation on MiniF2F, PutnamBench, and MathOlympiadBench but does not provide a released train/benchmark overlap or broader decontamination report.

items: Lean acceptance is conditional on the exact statement and environment; it does not validate autoformalization semantics or source provenance.
Formal goal extraction from an incorrect proof attempt can yield unprovable statements; adding a negation avoids assuming truth but changes the data distribution.
Qwen3-32B semantic and difficulty filters can reject valid hard statements or accept subtly incorrect ones.
Self-correction learns from compiler messages, which may encourage environment-specific repair patterns without improving mathematical planning.
Dynamic RL sampling removes unsolved prompts and prompts above 75% pass rate, concentrating optimization on a moving intermediate-difficulty band.
Model averaging changes pass@1/pass@N diversity and makes a single-checkpoint training lineage insufficient.
The paper and released model pages contain differing historical score and budget numbers; use the arXiv v1 paper for paper claims and pin artifact revisions for reproduction.
Core training statements, accepted and rejected traces, reward logs, per-item provenance, licenses, and decontamination records are not released.

value.html: The official repository badge and MathOlympiadBench card state Apache-2.0. Model pages and upstream corpora may carry separate terms; the paper does not provide a per-source license matrix for the unreleased training mixture.

Existing or generated math problem → Lean formalization and semantic checks → scaffolded theorem variants → teacher whole-proof inference → Lean-verified S1 → failed proof plus compiler error and correction annotation for S2 → scaffolded S3 → SFT, RL, and checkpoint averaging. Public model weights, inference/self-correction code, Lean compiler code, and MathOlympiadBench are available, but core S1/S2/S3 and RL record manifests are not.
